## Your question

_What do you want to understand?_

Example:
> "Pose's `CalcDSSP()` reports a different secondary-structure assignment than `mkdssp` for residue 42 of 1UBQ. Which is correct, and why?"

## What you've tried

_Code, papers consulted, alternative tools compared, etc._

## Context

- Which Pose function or capability is this about?
- Is the question about Pose's implementation, or about the underlying science (geometry, force field, biology)?
- If about implementation: which version? Reproduction?
- If about science: any references you've read?

## Scope check

This issue type is for questions where the maintainers' specific knowledge of Pose's implementation matters. For general structural-biology questions, [Bioinformatics Stack Exchange](https://bioinformatics.stackexchange.com/) often gives faster answers.

- [ ] I've checked the [docs](https://sarisabban.github.io/Pose)
- [ ] I've checked existing [Discussions](https://github.com/sarisabban/Pose/discussions)
- [ ] The question is specific to Pose's implementation (not general biology)
